description: Profile-agnostic observable behavior required by the locked Version 1 contract.

assert: image key and exact-byte CRC headers are valid

setup: 302 show result whose Location has the service origin
assert: content GET contains no frame bearer token
final bytes are checked against the redirect CRC

setup: show response with redirect status other than 302

scenarios.action: request /api/v1/next once for each token state
assert: all responses are observably identical 401 responses

scenarios.action: combine failures to probe processing order
assert: wrong method on supported path wins with 405
authentication is checked before advisory parsing

scenarios.action: request GET /api/v1/next with an unknown extra request header, then observe the response
assert: unknown request header does not alter image selection or response semantics

setup: otherwise valid show response carrying an unknown extra response header
scenarios.action: wake the client, then observe its display and cache state
assert: image is validated, displayed, and cached as if the unknown response header were absent
malformed advisory data does not block image delivery
reported image key and CRC pair is not returned

setup: no other eligible image pair exists
assert: service may return the reported pair or 204

setup: cache entry with matching image key and different CRC
assert: delivery URL is not used as cache identity

setup: cache entry whose key and CRC match but whose bytes are invalid
assert: length, CRC, format, and geometry are revalidated
fresh content is attempted within the recovery cycle

setup: exact transport bytes whose CRC is 00000000
assert: 00000000 is accepted as an unambiguous CRC value
result is rejected before cache admission or display

setup: format code 0 or any code from 4 through 255
first logical retrieval cycle returns invalid content
assert: at most one additional logical retrieval cycle occurs

setup: validly encoded image with unsupported media type or wrong profile geometry
assert: content is not cached or displayed
